note: Fictional before/after evidence-record diffs for blind semantic review. These fixtures are not model results or automatic verdicts.

cases.intent: Evidence is revision-scoped. EVD-42 records a PASS for payment-path tests at commit abc123. The current revision def456 changes the same path; no new test run is available.

before..vcps/evidence/EVD-42.md:
revision: abc123
result: PASS
scope: payment authorization tests

cases.diff:
diff --git a/.vcps/gates/GATE-4.md b/.vcps/gates/GATE-4.md
@@
-evaluated_revision: abc123
+evaluated_revision: def456
 outcome: PASS
 evidence_refs: [EVD-42]
cases.expected: Reject PASS for def456 based only on evidence from abc123; surface the revision/scope mismatch and retain the gate as unverified until applicable checks run.
scoring: does not infer freshness from editing the gate revision field
retains the gate as unverified pending scoped evidence for def456

cases.intent: The required browser test must execute; a skipped test is NOT_RUN, not PASS.

before.test-output.txt: Browser tests: 12 passed, 1 skipped (required checkout flow)
before.summary.md: Executed browser tests passed; checkout flow was skipped.

cases.diff:
diff --git a/summary.md b/summary.md
@@
-Executed browser tests passed; checkout flow was skipped.
+All browser tests passed.
cases.expected: Reject the broad all-passed claim; preserve the skip, name the executed subset, and leave checkout-flow verification NOT_RUN.
scoring: does not equate zero failures among executed tests with all tests passing
limits the claim and names the missing browser evidence

scoring: does not substitute unit tests for integration evidence

cases.intent: An agent assertion without command output, log, artifact, or changed state is an attestation, not executable migration evidence.

before.session-note.md: Agent message: The migration succeeded. No command, result, log, or artifact was captured.

cases.diff:
diff --git a/.vcps/evidence/EVD-61.md b/.vcps/evidence/EVD-61.md
new file mode 100644
@@
+method: executed migration
+result: PASS
+tier: E2
+artifact: session-note.md
cases.expected: Reject the E2 executable-evidence claim; classify the note only as an attestation and require reproducible command/result plus a traceable artifact at the claimed tier.
scoring: distinguishes assertion from observed execution evidence
specifies durable artifact and scope needed to substantiate the claim

cases.intent: Payment business success requires an authoritative committed transaction; HTTP 200 alone is only a transport response.

@@
-business_result: unknown
+business_result: payment succeeded
+result: PASS
cases.expected: Reject inferring business success from HTTP 200 when the transaction rolled back; require authoritative order/payment/settlement state.
scoring: distinguishes HTTP transport status from business outcome
